enemy.name: Quicksand Beast
enemy.flavour_text: 'The ground's shaking! It's quaking! It's...' Before the observer can finish, the Quicksand Beast has already closed the distance. Its long maw easily cleaves through rocks, while a casual flick of its tail stirs up dust clouds. Within seconds, it burrows deep beneath the rock layers, leaving only dusty faces.

abilities.text: Movement speed gradually increases while moving (up to a max). Upon colliding with allied units, deals Physical damage equal to a percentage of ATK and stuns them for several seconds.
Periodically stops moving and gains a Barrier equal to a percentage of max HP (does not stack).
Burrows underground when HP drops below a certain threshold, gaining increased DEF and RES. After some time, disappears and moves to another stage.
[Earth Spike] Gains the following ability in Strange Territory Difficulty 4: Collision damage has a greater area and reduces targets' ATK.
[Deep Dive] Gains the following ability in Strange Territory Difficulty 6: When Movement Speed is at max, tiles it passes through are no longer deployable.
